decisions.decision:
One spec item is still missing. X058 and the 2026-10-09 decision both say Zoom polls are created through the API, but the Zoom live-room card (workshop-cards.ts:1377) tells attendees to add the four polls by hand. Fix it:
1) In event-setup, after each attendee Pro meeting is created or scheduled, call Zoom's create-meeting-polls endpoint (POST /meetings/{id}/polls) with the four polls: persona, challenge, investment priority, discovery-call interest. For a challenge, title each poll by its day ('Day 1: Persona'). Do not create a poll twice on a re-run.
2) If Zoom refuses because a scope is missing, show a VendorError naming the scope to add (mark it UNVERIFIED in CHECKS.md). Keep the hand-made steps only as the fallback.
3) Rewrite card step 1377 as an auto block. Launching and ending polls stays a human step for the tech moderator.
4) Extend probe-t268 (simulator only) and run tsc.
5) Push, deploy, publish the mirror, add the commit to the X058 line in AUDIT.md, and set the task back to review.
decisions.why: X058 and the 2026-10-09 T-268 decision ask for polls via the API. The card still says to add them by hand. Event-setup already creates the attendee's Pro meetings, so creating polls the same way can be built. The mirror publish was approved but not done.
